Help.requestFeatureDetail: Tell us what to build next

Hero.description: Send money to loved ones abroad with clear rates, verified payouts, and delivery to mobile money or bank.

Destinations.title: Send money to multiple countries
Destinations.description: Send from the UK, France, Spain, and Morocco — receive in Ghana, Nigeria, Sierra Leone, Liberia, Kenya, Uganda, and Morocco.

HowItWorks.title: Three clear steps to send
HowItWorks.description: Built to feel fast without cutting corners on verification.

corridor.title: Choose corridor and amount
corridor.description: Select where you’re sending from, where it’s going, and how much. Rates and fees stay visible as you type.

recipient.title: Add your recipient
recipient.description: Enter their name, phone, and payout method — mobile money or bank — in under a minute.

pay.title: Pay, we verify, they receive
pay.description: Send the transfer with your reference, upload proof, and we confirm before payout begins.

Why.title: Built for trust on every transfer
Why.description: C.N International Money Transfer helps people send money across borders electronically — with security and speed at the center.

secure.title: Secure & reliable
secure.description: Payments are verified before processing. Your details stay protected throughout.

fast.title: Fast after confirmation
fast.description: Once payment is confirmed, most transfers complete within minutes — not days.

network.title: Wide receiving network
network.description: Reach family and partners across multiple countries via mobile money or bank.

verified.title: Verified before payout
verified.text: We confirm payment proof before processing begins.

references.title: Clear references
references.text: Every transfer gets a reference so support can help quickly.

support.title: Human support
support.text: Reach us on WhatsApp or phone when you need a hand.

FinalCta.title: Fast money transfer at your convenience
FinalCta.description: Start a transfer in about a minute. Pay when you’re ready — we’ll verify and keep you updated through payout.

Track.title: Check your transfer status
Track.description: Enter the reference from your confirmation email or receipt to see payment progress, verification, and payout status.
Track.lookingUpDescription: Fetching the latest status from our records.
Track.readyDescription: Your reference usually starts with TRANS-. You’ll see live progress once we find a match.
